pancreatitis.text: Extras need your vet's OK with pancreatitis (VCA: low-fat, easy-to-digest diet).

kidney.text: Extras need your vet's OK with kidney disease (therapeutic diet).

diabetes.text: Extras need your vet's OK with diabetes (our conservative rule).

vca_pancreatitis.quote: With mild pancreatitis, the treatment is supportive; it involves treating pain and nausea and feeding small amounts of a low-fat, easy-to-digest diet.

cornell_ckd_cats.quote: Studies suggest that therapeutic diets that are restricted in protein, phosphorus and sodium content and high in water-soluble vitamins, fiber, and antioxidant concentrations may prolong life and improve quality of life in cats with CKD.

merck_ckd_dogs.quote: It can involve controlling blood pressure, treating infections, switching to a kidney-support diet, decreasing the amount of phosphorus in the diet, adding fish oil to the diet, and giving medications or supplements.

vca_food_allergy.quote: The best and most accurate method of diagnosing a food allergy is to feed a hypoallergenic diet for 8 to 12 weeks as a food trial, called an elimination trial.

tufts_bland.org: Tufts Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine (Petfoodology)
tufts_bland.quote: one low fat example is cooked white rice and cooked chicken or turkey breast in a 2:1 ratio. For example, this would be 2 cups (approximately 300 grams) of cooked white rice and 1 cup (approximately 150 grams) of chopped baked chicken or turkey breast.
